title: Gallery pictures remain reachable with real drag, touch and keyboard input
steps: Run the browser fixture with DEMO_QA_CDP pointing to the owned Chromium instance.
Drag across a linked image, swipe through all seven mobile pictures, cancel a gesture, scroll vertically and navigate under reduced motion.
expect: Every gallery picture is reachable; a swipe does not activate a picture link and a plain click still does.
Vertical scrolling and pinch zoom remain native; cancellation does not strand the next swipe.
Tab reaches the carousel and arrow keys work with reduced motion.
evidence: Local Levain blue/green/pink/purple variants reproduced an unreachable seventh image before the fix; before/after logs and screenshots are in runs52.
fence: Real browser Pointer Events test includes transfer of implicit touch capture from the image to its carousel.
